notes.md: - **AP merchandise exports (FY 2024-25):** about **US$ 20.78 bn (₹1,84,277 crore)** (RBI state-wise data; IBEF).

new.s: Which of the following rules protecting human, animal and plant health is a non-tariff barrier under the WTO?
new.x: SPS measures are health rules for humans, animals and plants under the WTO SPS Agreement; they act as a non-tariff barrier.
new.angle: U0517 notes gap: SPS = non-tariff barrier

new.s: How is the Income Terms of Trade (ITT) measured?
o: Export price index / import price index × 100
Import price index × export quantity index
Net terms of trade × export quantity index
new.x: Income terms of trade = NTT multiplied by the export quantity index.
new.angle: U0517 notes gap: Income terms of trade formula

new.s: What was the value of India's electronics exports in 2024-25?
new.x: Electronics exports grew 32.46% to $38.56 bn in 2024-25.
new.angle: U0517 notes gap: electronics exports $38.56 bn

new.s: Which product made up about 62.5% of India's electronics exports in 2024-25?
new.x: Smartphones were 62.5% of India's electronics exports in 2024-25.
new.angle: U0517 notes gap: smartphones share of electronics exports

new.s: In 2018, which of the following, taken as a bloc, received the largest share of India's exports?
new.x: The EU as a bloc took the most Indian exports in 2018; the USA was the top single country.
new.angle: U0517 notes gap: EU bloc largest export destination 2018

new.s: Which country was India's largest export market among BRICS members in FY 2025-26?
new.x: UAE was India's largest BRICS export market ($37.4 bn) in FY26.
new.angle: U0517 notes gap: largest BRICS export market UAE

new.s: About what share of India's total exports did services account for, as reported in May 2026?
new.x: Services were about 49% of total exports, up from 39% in 2014.
new.angle: U0517 notes gap: services 49% of exports

new.s: According to UNCTAD's Trade and Development Report 2025, what was India's rank in the Global South for trade-partner diversity?
new.x: UNCTAD's TDR 2025 placed India 3rd in the Global South for trade-partner diversity.
new.angle: U0517 notes gap: UNCTAD TDR 2025 rank

new.s: In which year was the Special Economic Zone (SEZ) Policy announced in India?
new.x: The SEZ Policy was announced on 1 April 2000; the SEZ Act came in 2005 and the Rules in 2006.
new.angle: U0517 notes gap: SEZ Policy 1 April 2000

new.s: What was the main aim of the Agriculture Export Policy 2018?
o: To replace APEDA with a new board
To set up SEZs only for farm goods
new.x: The Agriculture Export Policy 2018 aimed to double India's agri exports.
new.angle: U0517 notes gap: Agriculture Export Policy 2018 aim

new.s: Which of the following Foreign Trade Policies has no fixed end date?
new.x: FTP 2023 came into force on 1 April 2023 with no end date.
new.angle: U0517 notes gap: FTP 2023 no end date

new.s: When was the India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) signed?
new.x: India and the UK signed the CETA on 24 July 2025.
new.angle: U0517 notes gap: India-UK CETA signed 24 July 2025

new.s: How many Free Trade Agreements and Preferential Trade Agreements had India signed as of April 2026?
new.x: India had 14 FTAs and 6 PTAs as of April 2026.
new.angle: U0517 notes gap: 14 FTAs and 6 PTAs

new.s: What was the value of merchandise exports from Andhra Pradesh in 2024-25?
new.x: RBI state-wise data and IBEF put AP's merchandise exports at about US$ 20.78 bn (₹1,84,277 crore) in FY25.
new.angle: U0517 web: AP exports value FY25 (keyword #7)

new.s: Up to what date was the Foreign Trade Policy 2015-20 extended?
new.x: FTP 2015-20 was extended (COVID-19, geopolitics) till 31 March 2023; FTP 2023 began on 1 April 2023.
new.angle: U0518 notes gap: FTP 2015-20 extended to 31 March 2023

new.s: Which body runs the RoDTEP scheme online?
new.x: RoDTEP refunds are run online by the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC).
new.angle: U0518 notes gap: RoDTEP run by CBIC

new.s: What does the Export Promotion Capital Goods (EPCG) scheme allow?
o: Duty-free import of inputs for export production
Refund of VAT on transport fuel
Zero-duty import of capital goods against an export obligation
new.x: EPCG allows zero-duty import of capital goods against an export obligation; Advance Authorisation covers inputs.
new.angle: U0518 notes gap: EPCG meaning

new.s: Which two schemes were merged into the Export Promotion Mission?
o: Interest Equalisation Scheme and Market Access Initiative
new.x: The Export Promotion Mission merges the Interest Equalisation Scheme and the Market Access Initiative.
new.angle: U0518 notes gap: Export Promotion Mission merger

new.s: Where is the EXIM Bank of India headquartered?
new.x: EXIM Bank was set up on 1 January 1982 at Mumbai under the EXIM Bank Act 1981.
new.angle: U0518 notes gap: EXIM Bank Mumbai

new.s: What is the full form of NIRVIK?
o: National Initiative for Rural Value-added Industrial Kits
new.x: NIRVIK = Niryat Rin Vikas Yojana, giving higher ECGC insurance cover to exporters.
new.angle: U0518 notes gap: NIRVIK full form

new.s: Where is the office of the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) located?
new.x: DGFT, an attached office of the Department of Commerce, is at Vanijya Bhavan, New Delhi.
new.angle: U0518 notes gap: DGFT Vanijya Bhavan

new.s: Under Districts as Export Hubs, in how many districts had export products been identified by 2025?
new.x: Products were identified in 734 districts and action plans prepared for 590 (2025).
new.angle: U0518 notes gap: DEH 734 districts

new.s: In export-import trade, what is an indent?
o: The shipping company's document of title
The customs document for export goods
The importer's order to buy goods
The ship's mate's acknowledgement of loading
new.x: An indent is the importer's order to buy goods.
new.angle: U0518 notes gap: indent purpose

new.s: Which body releases the LEADS (Logistics Ease Across Different States) index?
o: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
new.x: LEADS 2025, the 7th edition, was released by DPIIT on 13 May 2026.
new.angle: U0518 notes gap: LEADS publisher DPIIT

new.s: In LEADS 2025, which coastal state was placed in the 'Exemplar' category?
new.x: In LEADS 2025, Tamil Nadu was an Exemplar while Andhra Pradesh was an Accelerator.
new.angle: U0518 notes gap: LEADS 2025 Exemplar Tamil Nadu

new.s: Along with rupee trade settlement, which kind of trade does the Foreign Trade Policy 2023 promote?
new.x: FTP 2023 promotes international trade in INR and merchanting trade.
new.angle: U0518 notes gap: FTP 2023 merchanting trade

new.s: In which year was the Foreign Exchange Regulation Act (FERA) enacted?
new.x: FERA was enacted in 1973; FEMA replaced it in 1999 (in force 2000).
new.angle: U0519 notes gap: FERA 1973

new.s: What was India's current account deficit in Q1 2026-27?
new.x: Q1 2026-27 CAD was $4.2 bn, 0.5% of GDP, against $3.4 bn (0.4%) a year earlier.
new.angle: U0519 notes gap: Q1 2026-27 CAD

new.s: To what level did India's services exports rise in FY 2023-24?
new.x: Services exports rose 4.85% to USD 341.06 bn in FY 2023-24, cushioning the deficit.
new.angle: U0519 notes gap: services exports FY24

new.s: How much did Foreign Portfolio Investors pull out of India in FY 2025-26?
new.x: FPIs pulled out $16.4 bn in FY26, while net FDI was only $6.9 bn.
new.angle: U0519 notes gap: FPI outflow FY26

new.s: What was India's total external debt at end-June 2026?
new.x: External debt was $778.2 bn at end-June 2026, 20.8% of GDP.
new.angle: U0519 notes gap: external debt end-June 2026

new.s: Which RBI step drove India's overall BoP surplus of $20.8 bn in July 2026?
new.x: The RBI's special FCNR(B) deposit scheme drew NRI deposits and gave a $20.8 bn overall BoP surplus.
new.angle: U0519 notes gap: FCNR(B) scheme July 2026

new.s: According to the RBI's remittances survey for 2023-24, which country was the second-largest source of remittances to India?
new.x: The RBI survey ranked USA (27.7%) first, UAE (19.2%) second and UK (10.8%) third in 2023-24.
new.angle: U0519 web: remittances -> top source countries (keyword #9)

new.s: Which country's share in remittances to India rose to 10.8% in 2023-24, making it the third-largest source?
new.x: The UK's share rose from 6.8% (2021-22) to 10.8% (2023-24), third after USA and UAE.
new.angle: U0519 web: remittances -> UK third (keyword #14)

new.s: Who issued the Resurgent India Bonds in August 1998?
new.x: SBI issued the Resurgent India Bonds on 5 August 1998 in US dollar, pound sterling and Deutsche Mark.
new.angle: U0520 notes gap: Resurgent India Bonds issuer SBI

new.s: Under the SAARC Currency Swap Framework 2024-27, what is the size of the INR window?
new.x: The 2024-27 framework has a ₹250 bn INR window plus a $2 bn USD-euro facility.
new.angle: U0520 notes gap: SAARC swap INR window

new.s: In which year did the RBI put in place the framework for invoicing and settling international trade in rupees?
new.x: The RBI's INR trade settlement framework came in July 2022 and was built into FTP 2023.
new.angle: U0520 notes gap: INR trade settlement July 2022

new.s: Since 2025, in which instruments may surplus balances in Special Rupee Vostro Accounts be invested?
new.x: Since 2025, SRVA surplus balances may go into corporate bonds and CPs.
new.angle: U0520 notes gap: SRVA surplus in corporate bonds/CPs

new.s: How many of the 27 European Union member states use the euro?
new.x: The euro is used by 20 of the 27 EU states.
new.angle: U0520 notes gap: euro 20 of 27

new.s: Where was the Bretton Woods Conference of July 1944 held?
new.x: The Bretton Woods Conference (1-22 July 1944, 44 nations) was held in New Hampshire, USA.
new.angle: U0520 notes gap: Bretton Woods New Hampshire

new.s: Ngultrum is the currency of which country?
new.x: Bhutan's currency is the ngultrum; Maldives uses the rufiyaa.
new.angle: U0520 notes gap: ngultrum Bhutan

new.s: In which Union Budget was the Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA) first proposed?
new.x: FEMA was proposed in the 1997-98 Budget, enacted in 1999 and in force from 1 June 2000.
new.angle: U0520 notes gap: FEMA proposed 1997-98 Budget

new.s: By about what percentage was the rupee devalued in June 1966?
new.x: In June 1966 the rupee was devalued by 57.5%, from ₹4.76 to ₹7.50 per US dollar.
new.angle: U0520 notes gap: 1966 devaluation 57.5%

new.s: By about what percentage was the rupee devalued in September 1949?
new.x: India's first devaluation, in September 1949 along with sterling, was about 30.5%.
new.angle: U0520 notes gap: 1949 devaluation 30.5%

new.s: Which WTO Ministerial Conference was held at Buenos Aires in 2017?
new.x: MC11 was held at Buenos Aires in 2017; it ended with no declaration.
new.angle: U0521 notes gap: MC11 Buenos Aires 2017

new.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the 'Singapore issues' raised at the first WTO Ministerial Conference (1996)?
new.x: The Singapore issues were investment, competition, transparency in procurement and trade facilitation.
new.angle: U0521 notes gap: Singapore issues MC1

new.s: At which WTO Ministerial Conference was the COVID-19 TRIPS waiver adopted?
new.x: MC12 at Geneva (June 2022) adopted the COVID TRIPS waiver along with the Fisheries Subsidies Agreement.
new.angle: U0521 notes gap: MC12 COVID TRIPS waiver

new.s: Under the Agreement on Agriculture, by how much did developed countries have to cut export subsidies over six years?
new.x: Developed countries had to cut export subsidies by 36% in value or 21% in volume over 6 years from 1986-90 levels.
new.angle: U0521 notes gap: AoA export subsidy cut 36%/21%

new.s: Which Indian law is linked to the WTO SPS and TBT agreements on food safety and standards?
o: Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights Act, 2001
new.x: India's compliance with SPS/TBT is through the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006.
new.angle: U0521 notes gap: SPS/TBT -> FSS Act 2006

new.s: Which organisations set up the Codex Alimentarius Commission in 1963?
new.x: The Codex Alimentarius Commission was set up by FAO and WHO in 1963; the WTO uses its food-safety standards.
new.angle: U0521 notes gap: Codex founders FAO+WHO

new.s: Along with the IMF and the World Bank, which body is called the third pillar of the world economy?
new.x: The WTO is the third pillar of the world economy with the IMF and the World Bank.
new.angle: U0521 notes gap: WTO third pillar

new.s: In which year was the Uruguay Round of GATT negotiations concluded?
new.x: The Uruguay Round ran from 1986 to 1993; the Marrakesh Agreement followed in April 1994.
new.angle: U0521 notes gap: Uruguay Round concluded 1993

new.s: In which year was the FDI limit in private sector banks raised from 49% to 74%?
new.x: FDI in private banks was 49% (2003) and was raised to 74% in 2004.
new.angle: U0522 notes gap: private bank FDI 74% in 2004

new.s: Which country was the third-largest source of FDI into India in FY 2024-25?
new.x: In FY25, Singapore (30%) led, followed by Mauritius (17%) and the US (11%).
new.angle: U0522 notes gap: FY25 FDI sources US third

new.s: How is a Foreign Currency Convertible Bond (FCCB) classified among forms of foreign capital?
new.x: ECBs, trade credit and FCCBs are debt forms of foreign capital.
new.angle: U0522 notes gap: FCCB = debt

new.s: In which of the following is FDI prohibited in India?
new.x: Trading in TDRs is in the prohibited list; medical devices, railway infrastructure and ports allow 100% automatic FDI.
new.angle: U0522 notes gap: prohibited: TDR trading

new.s: Which sector had the largest share (25.8%) within services FDI inflows during FY23-FY25?
new.x: Services took 80.2% of FDI in FY23-FY25, with information and communication at 25.8%.
new.angle: U0522 notes gap: information and communication 25.8%
